name: 四聲杜鵑
illustrationTaxon: Cuculus micropterus adult male grey morph

similarSpecies.distinction: Adult grey male representative nominate-type: YELLOW iris and eye ring, fine belly crossbars, relatively pale grey mantle vs Oriental but bakeri dark overlaps. No clearcut white UNDERWING bar vs Oriental; folded-wing image does NOT demonstrate this flight trait. Europe/N Africa/SWAsia/Russia/Mongolia/N Central China/Kamchatka/Japan and Himalaya/N Indochina/SChina breeding, winters Africa/S SEAsia. LC stable; HK accidental/rare spring, subspecies uncertain.

Adult grey male BROWN iris yellow ring, dark grey mantle, much BROADER widely spaced belly bars vs common/lesser; some birds buff undertail broad bars. Broad white underwing bar is flight trait NOT demonstrated in folded-wing art. Visually indistinguishable from Himalayan Cuckoo C.saturatus; usually measurements/song required. Breeds W Russia/Siberia/Kamchatka S Kazakhstan/Altai/Mongolia/NChina/Korea/Japan, winters SEAsia/Australia. Taiwan breeding taxonomy uncertain EXCLUDED map. LC decreasing.
